dict.string: Argus Server needs access to your Desktop so agents can read and edit files in projects you keep there.
Argus Server needs access to your Documents so agents can read and edit files in projects you keep there.
Argus Server needs access to your Downloads so agents can read files you've downloaded into projects.
Argus Server needs access to removable volumes so agents can read files from external drives.
Argus Server needs access to network volumes so agents can read files from mounted shares.
Argus Server uses Apple Events to control developer tools (simulators, terminals) on your behalf.
Argus Server performs system administration tasks to manage simulators, emulators, and developer tooling.
